materials_exhausted.note: All local materials identified in handoff_context, packet_manifest, locator_index, OA packages, supplement PDFs/text, and linked database snapshots were opened or checked. No blocking local material gap remains.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review repaired the scaffold outputs: all 28 Table 1 DBAASP IC50 rows are now source-located and cross-checked, DRAMP antimicrobial/linear-sequence conflicts are preserved as cautions, and final mechanism claims are limited to anticancer apoptosis evidence supported by XML figures/methods.
summary: Accepted with cautions after bounded worker-4/worker-6 re-review. The paper is publication-grade for obtainable local material because remaining DRAMP conflicts are explicit, nonblocking database cautions and no open rework target remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP IC50 assay and experiment rows match Table 1 values, targets, units, DOI/PMID/title and are source_verified. DRAMP rows are retained as source_conflict because the local primary paper supports anticancer cyclic analogs but not antimicrobial activity or linear/free-termini sequence annotations.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: The malformed one-row activity scaffold was replaced with all 28 source-supported Table 1 IC50 records, preserving raw values, µg/mL units, target cell lines, assay conditions, XML locators, and DBAASP cross-checks.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are restricted to direct in vitro anticancer apoptosis evidence: MTT/SAR, sub-G1 and Annexin/Hoechst apoptosis phenotype, and Western blot caspase/PARP pathway support in HepG2 cells.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_layer: Supplement PDFs/text were checked; they provide spectral/HPLC characterization and Figure S1 Hoechst support, not extra activity tables needing material rework.

caution_findings.note: DRAMP rows retain unsupported antimicrobial activity and linear/free-termini modified-sequence annotations; these are preserved as conflicts rather than promoted to source_verified.
DBAASP/DRAMP symbolic X/x modified-residue strings are kept as database notation and not normalized into plain peptide sequences.
Local supplement contains Figure S1 and MS/MS/NMR/HPLC characterization figures for analogs, not additional activity/toxicity tables that change Table 1 curation.
Mechanism evidence supports HepG2 apoptosis/mitochondria-mediated pathway for Analog-6; this paper does not support antimicrobial mechanism claims.
